articles.title: BRS Alleges ₹600 Crore Gap in Telangana Road Tenders
articles.description: HYDERABAD: Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) spokesperson Dinesh Chowdhary has alleged irregularities in the tendering process for the Budvel and Kodangal radial road projects. He questioned the reported rejection of the lowest bidder and the award of contracts to bidders who quoted more than ₹600 crore above the lowest bid. BRS questions rejection of lowest bidder […]HYDERABAD: Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) spokesperson Dinesh Chowdhary has alleged irregularities in the tendering process for the Budvel and Kodangal radial road projects. He questioned the reported rejection of the lowest bidder and the award of contracts to bidders who quoted more than ₹600 crore above the lowest bid. Chowdhary said government procurement tenders should generally be awarded to the L1 bidder, who quotes the lowest price. However, he alleged that the lowest bidder in this case was set aside on technical grounds after submitting the bid. He also questioned the speed of the tender allocation process. According to him, contractors who quoted more than ₹600 crore above the L1 bid were awarded the tenders within six days. Spokesperson alleges political link to bidder Chowdhary further alleged that the company which submitted the L1 bid belongs to a Congress MLA. He raised the issue while questioning the reported handling of the tender process. The allegations have not been independently established from the material provided. The response of the state government and the contractors concerned was not included in the source material. ]]>

articles.title: KTR seeks cancellation of Rs 3,296-crore Telangana road tenders, alleges irregularities
articles.description: KT Rama Rao has raised concerns about irregularities in the Radial Road-2 tender process, alleging misconduct by the Telangana government. He questions the fairness of contractor selections and disqualifications of lower bidders. Rao demands a comprehensive inquiry and the cancellation of the tenders due to potential financial loss. He insists on transparency in all tendering processes to protect public funds.

articles.title: KTR alleges Rs 3,296-cr scam in Telangana's Radial Road-2 tender
articles.description: BRS leader KTR accuses Telangana's Congress govt of a Rs 3,296-crore scam in the Radial Road-2 tender, alleging irregularities. He demands cancellation of tenders, a comprehensive inquiry, and disclosure of all related project documents.

articles.title: Servants, Tea Vendors And ₹700 Crore In Government Contracts. The Alleged Medical Procurement Scam Around Rajiv Rangila. How Did Delhi’s Government Hospital Procurement System Allegedly Go Wrong?
articles.description: Servants and tea vendors allegedly linked to companies winning government contracts. Medical supplies reportedly bought at multiples of their market prices. And ₹700 crore under the scanner. The Rajiv Rangila case raises an uncomfortable question: how did Delhi’s government hospital procurement system allegedly allow this to happen?
